conclusion: No Hyle loss reproduced in these two fixed AB/BA processes. Cross-process drift and epoch overlap are substantial; no general or stable superiority claim, no product queue change.

trace.payload: 262144 scalar uint64 values1..262144 per transfer, every pop exact FIFO value checked, final sum and empty checked. Before timing both fill1024, reject overflow, drain exact values and reject underflow.
trace.capacity: Hyle requested1024 and actual Folly constructor1025, both1024 usable sentinel slots. Original actual Folly uses32-bit atomic indices, Hyle uses size_t; both domains sufficient for this capacity.
trace.boundary: Both queues constructed before all timing. For each arm exactly one persistent producer/consumer pair is created, pinned and warmed once outside timing. Timed callback includes coordinator generation notify/wait, full transfer, exact checks, checksum and empty. Worker join/destruction outside timing, both queues destroyed after all timing/output. Spin retries have no yield for either peer.
trace.unit: One transferred item includes one successful scalar push and pop. Raw elapsed is seconds per262144-item complete transfer. It is not the ST512 per-individual-operation unit.
trace.resources: Same group0 three distinct highest-efficiency physical cores: producerLP0, consumerLP2, coordinatorLP4. Process mask0x15 and ABOVE_NORMAL; actual worker masks/current CPUs read back. Runtime auxiliary threads not enumerated or constrained.
trace.schedule: Fixed AB then BA, nine epochs per arm, minEpochTime20ms/minEpochIterations3, all36epochs retained. No AA because no current Hyle loss; no trimming/additional shape.

clock.note: Clock tick differs from epoch and cross-process variation. Some large epochs/outliers retained without filtering.

implementation.observed_layout: Hyle384B align128; Folly256B align64, reported hardware_destructive_interference_size64. No layout equalization or product change.

limits: One Windows13900K uint64 capacity1024 trace. No full/allocation/cancellation stress, other systems/topologies, large-capacity domain, bulk API or MPMC result. Formal spsc_bench still explicitly labels its old local shape; this evidence uses actual Folly.
